protocol.boundary: Five existing native stages inside the same three native video-pipeline Core calls; stage synchronization and CPU metadata bookkeeping are additional diagnostic overhead. Input read/adaptation, H2D and CPU output transfer remain outside Core.
frozen_execution_unchanged: posterior sampling shape/count and continuous RNG
protocol.changes: Observation only: allocated/reserved before/after/max, capture maxima before peak-stat resets, tensor storage/slice probes, positional decode argument probes. No empty_cache or native cache cleanup.
protocol.aggregation: Equal mean over four scenes, two repeats each; population standard deviation over eight measured clips. Per-scene repeat statistics are descriptive (n=2).

core_comparison.interpretation: Diagnostic mean is 0.057911s (0.287932%) above official Core. This difference includes instrumentation and separate-run variation, not an isolated causal estimate of synchronization overhead. Unattributed time includes VAE dtype casts, pipeline glue/output formatting and instrumentation outside phase timers; it is not the same quantity as profile-minus-official. Formal efficiency values are unchanged. No cross-GPU speedup is computed.

memory_boundary: Allocated peaks include resident weights, live inputs, native caches, operator outputs/workspaces and other temporary tensors. Entry-relative increments are not pure activation memory. Stage peaks are maxima and cannot be added. Reserved is allocator-held capacity, remains high after warmup, and is not a sum of module costs or sampled whole-device VRAM.

cache.deduplication: Deduplicate by device type/index and untyped storage pointer; all four RGB caches own distinct full-size storages in every observed snapshot.
cache.RGB_lifetime: Old four-level cache remains present at RGB encoder entry; new storages replace it only after native RGB encoding. CoC encoding, UNet and decode retain the current RGB cache; no profiler clearing.
cache.slice_verification: Each of 16 skip-convolution inputs per clip aliases the expected cached storage, uses FP32 shape [8,C,H,W], and has start_frame*C*H*W storage offset. These slices retain their backing 16-slot storage.

latent_cache.relation: First native call receives None; each following call receives exactly the prior returned cache storage/view. It carries four weighted trailing latent slots. It is distinct from the 6.46875GiB RGB skip cache. New clip resets only latent_cache per original infer code.

frame_topology.encoded: Six length-8 windows start at source frames 0,4,8,12,16,20. Last window has frames20..24 plus three zero-input padding slots:48 total,45 real-frame visits,25 unique frames,20 repeated visits.
frame_topology.decoded: Four actual length-8 calls decode32 slots:29 real-frame visits,25 unique frames,four repeated tail-context visits and three padding slots. Native last-batch selection retains only slot12 (source24) from the second final chunk, alongside the first24 outputs, producing8/8/9.
frame_topology.RGB_cache_relation: First two output chunks use the first window cache from their respective pairs. Final first chunk uses source16..23 cache; final second chunk uses source20..24+padding cache. Weighted overlapping latent sums do not imply repeated slots are removable; temporal decoding uses complete 8-slot context.

validation.nested_peak_reset_guard: CPU mocked reset inside an active stage preserves prior allocated/reserved maxima and positional arguments; all real runs have18 resets (3 units+15 stages), zero resets inside an active stage. Observed clip maxima are collected across resets rather than using the last unit counter.

verified_facts: VAE RGB/CoC encoding and overlap+temporal VAE decoding account for80.3612% of the instrumented4090D Core; old PRO6000 profile was81.0144%. Both support VAE-first diagnostic priority.
RGB and CoC encoding both peak near34.29GiB allocated; UNet peaks near14.39GiB, overlap+decode near29.65GiB. The largest retained RGB cache level occupies4.5GiB out of6.46875GiB.
Per25 emitted frames, native RGB/CoC encoders and CLIP visit48 slots; temporal VAE actually decodes32 slots. Counts include overlapping context and three padded slots.
All five native stage times are higher on4090D than in old PRO6000 profile. Cache sizes, shapes, precision and stage allocated peaks remain close; device results are labeled separately.
unresolved: No operator-level live-allocation trace: resident parameters, current cache, previous cache coexistence, transient activations and workspaces cannot be fully separated by these stage peaks.
No causal decomposition of GPU architecture, bandwidth, kernel choice or clock effects; the native stage comparison does not isolate hardware causes.
No proof that overlapping/padded slots can be omitted or reused without affecting posterior sampling or temporal decode context.
No optimization, output equivalence or full quality reevaluation has been performed.

proposed_single_next_experiment.factor: VAE encoder microbatch:16 frame slots ->8, all other semantics frozen
proposed_single_next_experiment.purpose: Separate encoder batch-dependent temporary memory from the fixed full16-slot RGB skip cache. Target both RGB and CoC phases, which both set the native peak.
proposed_single_next_experiment.constraints: Preserve native two-window pipeline inputs, FP32 force_upcast, full16-slot ordered RGB cache and original decode. Reassemble posterior parameters before the original single16-slot sampling call, preserving sampling count/shape and RNG stream; do not independently sample the two microbatches.
proposed_single_next_experiment.checks: First verify shapes/cache order, RNG state/call shape and small-sample output differences, then measure RGB/CoC and whole-Core allocated/reserved peaks and time. Numerical/output equivalence and total improvement must be measured; neither is assumed. No code for this proposal was implemented or executed.
